items.q: One army camp that we played, not far from our camp, was where the Japanese general Yamashita, who had lead the invasion of the Philippines was hanged.

ctx.x: After a few weeks at this camp, one of the best straight men in show business joined our group. For the sake of those that don't know about show business, or never saw vaudeville, a straight man was one that assisted the comedian by asking him a straight question and getting a comical or double meaning answer to make the audiance laugh. Johnny Vigel was this fellow's name, and he was well known in Negro Theatres from coast to coast. Alfred "Slick" Chester was another well known straight man who had been engaged…
One army camp that we played, not far from our camp, was where the Japanese general Yamashita, who had lead the invasion of the Philippines was hanged.

Some weeks passed and a big U.S.O. show was arranged in the largest stadium in Manila with the participation of all the U.S.O. groups that were assembled in the area. Kirby Alexander had lost face with Herbie Cowen and Herbie had Kirby sent home. There was no replacement for Kirby, so there was only Spider and myself in the front line.
